# Two Extra Attacks (`features:fighter-two-extra-attacks`)
**Class:** [Fighter](../classes/fighter.md) | **Level:** [Fighter 11](../levels/fighter-11.md)

You can attack three times instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
